citations.title: What is Koodisi? — Enterprise iPaaS Platform by Ivoyant
excerpts: Koodisi is an enterprise iPaaS platform — a software product by Ivoyant LLC that connects your entire stack with no-code workflow automation and built-in API management.
[Request a Demo](https://koodisi.com/request-demo) [See Comparisons](https://koodisi.com/compare)
## Koodisi is an Enterprise Integration Platform (iPaaS)
**Koodisi** connects your entire enterprise stack — CRM,
ERP, HRMS, ITSM, file systems, and REST APIs — through no-code workflow automation. It is designed
for organizations that need more than simple trigger-action automation: Koodisi adds governance,
real-time execution tracing, API management, and AI-assisted pipeline tooling on top of core
integration capabilities. Unlike lightweight automation tools, Koodisi is purpose-built for
production environments where reliability, auditability, and access control are non-negotiable.
## Who is Koodisi for?
Koodisi is designed for enterprise and mid-market organizations that need reliable,
governed integration infrastructure — not just a collection of automations. It is
particularly well-suited for:
* → **IT and integration teams** that manage complex cross-system workflows and need a structured deployment pipeline with change control.
* → **Operations teams** that need full visibility into running workflows and the ability to resolve failures without filing a ticket with engineering.
* → **Engineering leaders** who want to give business users self-service automation without losing control over production systems.

basis.reasoning: Koodisi is described as Ivoyant’s enterprise integration platform, with no-code workflow automation and built-in API management connecting business systems; its stated audience includes enterprise and mid-market IT/integration, operations, and engineering teams.

citations.title: V 1.2.7 | Koodisi Documentation
excerpts: _October 2026 | Released to Beta and Production_
## Koodisi AI: build, deploy and test from the chat ​
Koodisi AI brings workflow building, deployment and testing into one place, taking a workflow from first draft to tested deployment without leaving the chat.

* **Better workflow building, with a live preview.** Koodisi AI builds workflows more reliably, including subflows, mappings and tables. The canvas preview updates as each change lands, so you review the result while Koodisi AI works.
* **Revert changes.** Undo the changes Koodisi AI made and return the workflow to its earlier state.
* **Create alerts from the chat.** Describe what you want to monitor and Koodisi AI sets up the alert. Review a confirmation card before the alert is saved.

* **Publish, deploy and test.** Koodisi AI publishes and deploys using the same steps as the Deploy dialog, with a changelog that names every step and field that changed. Test runs resume after a deploy, and failures include buttons that take you to the problem.

basis.reasoning: Koodisi release notes date version 1.2.7 to October 2026 and mark it released to beta and production; they describe the new ability to build, deploy, and test workflows from Koodisi AI chat, a major feature within the six-month window.
